description:
The output layer drops one unused constructor and four places where the same text is rendered twice, so each rendering has one implementation.

## Background

A read-only survey of `crates/jit/src/output.rs`, `output/` and `dispatch/` (2026-11-04) found code that nothing calls and renderers written twice. `JsonError::gate_not_found` has no caller, because the classifier builds the gate-not-found envelope directly. `resolve_gate_key` states its two usage lines in both error arms. The graph and issue outputs each wrap the shared issue-list renderer in their own near-identical helper. The dependency add and remove renderers repeat the same count header and labelled bullet section. The issue listing and issue search results each keep an intermediate `render` method beside their `HumanRender` impls.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `JsonError::gate_not_found` no longer exists, and no import it alone needed remains.
- [hard] REQ-02: `resolve_gate_key` states its usage text once.
- [hard] REQ-03: The graph and issue outputs render issue lists through one shared helper, and the dependency add and remove renderers share one section helper. Their human output is byte-identical to before.
- [hard] REQ-04: The issue listing and search results render through their `HumanRender` impls without separate intermediate `render` methods.
- [hard] REQ-05: The change removes at least 20 production lines from `crates/jit/src` (default mode of `scripts/production-lines.py`), and no command's JSON payload, human output or exit code changes.

## Decisions

- D-01: REQ-05's line target is at least 20, amended from 25: the 25 was a survey estimate, and the implemented change measures -23 production lines (`scripts/production-lines.py`, branch head against merge base) with the structural criteria met and output byte-identical (steward ruling, 2026-11-04).

## Notes

Part of the epic's net-reduction work (plan D-51). Existing tests pin the rendered text; no test is weakened.
title: Output renderers have one implementation each
